description: Synthetic memory units of the 'Portal de Clientes' demo project (English content, as stored by gmemo).

units.title: Send customer notifications asynchronously through an outbox worker
units.summary: Notifications are written to an outbox table and delivered by a background worker.
units.body: The request handler only inserts into notification_outbox; src/notifications/outboxWorker.ts delivers with retries. A failed provider call no longer fails the customer request.

units.title: Cache customer profile reads in Redis for 30 minutes
units.summary: Profile reads are served from Redis with a 30-minute TTL and invalidated on update.
units.body: ProfileService.get() reads through Redis (key profile:<id>). Every write path calls invalidateProfile().

units.title: Customer PII never leaves the eu-west-1 region
units.summary: Personal data is stored and processed only in eu-west-1, including backups and logs.
units.body: Contractual and GDPR requirement. Applies to databases, object storage, log sinks and third-party processors.

units.title: Invoice PDF export times out for statements over 500 lines
units.summary: The synchronous PDF renderer exceeds the gateway timeout for large statements.
units.body: src/billing/invoicePdf.ts renders in memory; large statements return 504. Paginate the export as a workaround.

units.title: Wrap outbound HTTP calls with the shared retry helper
units.summary: Third-party calls go through withRetry() with jittered exponential backoff.
units.body: Use withRetry() from src/lib/http/retry.ts: 3 attempts, retries only on 429/5xx and network errors.

units.title: Paginate list endpoints with opaque keyset cursors
units.summary: List endpoints return an opaque nextCursor instead of page numbers.
units.body: Sort by (created_at DESC, id DESC) and encode the last key as base64url. Offset pagination drifted under concurrent writes.

units.title: Payment gateway sandbox returns HTTP 200 for declined cards
units.summary: In the sandbox a declined card still answers 200; read the status field.
units.body: Check response.status === 'declined' in src/payments/gatewayClient.ts. Production answers 402.

units.title: Email provider rate-limits bulk sends to 100 messages per second
units.summary: Bulk campaigns above 100 msg/s get 429 responses and are dropped.
units.body: Throttle bulk sends in src/notifications/bulk.ts to 80 msg/s with EMAIL_BULK_RATE.

units.title: Refunds above 500 EUR require a second approver
units.summary: Large refunds stay pending until a different back-office user approves them.
units.body: RefundService.request() creates a pending_approval refund above the threshold.

units.title: Moving sessions to Redis cut login p95 from 900 ms to 180 ms
units.summary: Redis-backed sessions reduced login latency fivefold.
units.body: Measured over two weeks after the rollout; database CPU on the auth path dropped by 35%.

units.title: Daylight saving change runs the nightly billing job twice
units.summary: A local-time cron triggers the 02:30 billing job twice on the autumn DST change.
units.body: Set CRON_TZ=UTC in infra/cron/billing.yaml and make the job idempotent per billing day.

units.title: Public API responses never expose internal account flags
units.summary: risk_score and fraud_review are stripped from public profile responses.
units.body: ProfileSerializer.toPublic() whitelists exposed fields; internal flags need the staff role.

units.title: A new email address is pending until the customer verifies it
units.summary: Changing the account email keeps the old address until the new one is confirmed.
units.body: AccountService.changeEmail() sends a confirmation link valid for 24 hours.

units.title: Outbox worker must acknowledge jobs only after the provider accepts the email
units.summary: Acknowledging before delivery loses notifications when the provider is down.
units.body: In src/notifications/outboxWorker.ts call ack() after the provider returns 2xx, never before.

units.title: Store uploaded documents in S3 with server-side encryption
units.summary: Customer documents go to a private S3 bucket encrypted with KMS.
units.body: Uploads use presigned PUT URLs; the API never proxies file bytes. Bucket policy denies unencrypted puts.

units.title: Use idempotency keys on payment and refund POSTs
units.summary: Clients send an Idempotency-Key header; the API replays the first response for repeats.
units.body: Keys are stored for 24 hours in the idempotency_keys table; a conflicting body returns 422.

units.title: Address validation service rejects postcodes with spaces
units.summary: The external address API expects postcodes without spaces.
units.body: Normalise with postcode.replace(/\s+/g, '') before calling AddressClient.validate().

units.title: Async notifications removed checkout timeouts during the sales campaign
units.summary: After moving to the outbox worker, no checkout request timed out during peak traffic.
units.body: Peak of 1,200 orders per minute; previously 3% of checkouts timed out waiting for the email provider.

units.title: Redis eviction drops profile cache keys under memory pressure
units.summary: With allkeys-lru the profile cache is evicted first during traffic spikes.
units.body: Monitor evicted_keys; size the cache node so profile keys fit, or use volatile-lru with TTLs.

units.title: Customers can download invoices for the last 24 months only
units.summary: Older invoices are archived and available on request through support.
units.body: InvoiceService.list() filters by issued_at >= now() - 24 months; archived invoices live in cold storage.
